items.title: Suzlon to challenge SEBI's Rs 28.6 crore penalty, plans SAT appeal
items.description: Suzlon plans to challenge SEBI's Rs 28.6-crore penalty order before SAT, arguing that the regulator had reversed an earlier 2025 adjudication order that had closed proceedings without imposing any penalty.

items.title: SpaceX, OpenAI windfall fuels bets on next-wave Asian AI winners
items.description: Adani Group’s push into green-powered data centers is driving gains in its energy units, providing India with one of its few AI bets.
